units.source_text: 此五节舞姬是筑紫太宰大弍的女儿，与源氏有私。

en.t: This Gosechi dancer was the daughter of the Daini of Dazaifu in Tsukushi, and she had a private relationship with Genji.

units.source_text: 参看第二百六十五、二百九十一至二百九十二页。
本回题名“少女”，即根据此诗和下面夕雾赠惟光女儿之诗。

en.t: The title of this chapter, Maiden, is based on this poem and on the poem below that Yugiri gives to Koremitsu's daughter.
